description: Gold ETF basket: mark-to-mid P&L (% + M IRT), equal-weight mid indexes (All / Top5) and portfolio excess vs those benchmarks, portfolio weights, signal edges, rotation execution quality (expected/last/realized/realized_net edge, fees, slippage, latency).

panels.description: Latest session mark-to-mid P&L from portfolio_snapshot, in million IRT (IRR / 1e7). Green if ≥ 0.

targets.rawSql: SELECT pnl / 1e7 AS pnl_m_irt FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot WHERE session_id = $session ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1;

panels.title: P&L (M IRT)

panels.description: Latest P&L as % of session start NAV: 100 * pnl / start_value (first portfolio_snapshot of the session).

targets.rawSql: WITH start_nav AS (SELECT portfolio_value AS v FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot WHERE session_id = $session ORDER BY ts ASC LIMIT 1), latest AS (SELECT pnl FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot WHERE session_id = $session ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT 100.0 * latest.pnl / NULLIF(start_nav.v, 0) AS pnl_pct FROM latest, start_nav;

panels.title: P&L (%)

panels.description: Latest mark-to-mid NAV from portfolio_snapshot only (IRR / 1e7).

targets.rawSql: SELECT portfolio_value / 1e7 AS portfolio_m_irt FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot WHERE session_id = $session ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1;

panels.title: Portfolio value (M IRT)

panels.description: Count of rotation rows with status ≠ buy_complete (in-flight started/sell_complete/buy_partial, failed/cancelled, or unfinished cash_collector). High means stuck or unfinished legs.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS incomplete FROM pair_trade.rotation WHERE session_id = $session AND status <> 'buy_complete';

panels.title: Incomplete rotations

panels.description: Among sell→buy rotations only (excludes cash_collector / prev_symbol=CASH): 100 × count(status=buy_complete) / count(*). Measures how often both legs finish.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'buy_complete' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) END AS complete_rate FROM pair_trade.rotation WHERE session_id = $session AND prev_symbol <> 'CASH';

panels.title: Rotation complete %

panels.description: Sum(quote_earned − quote_spent) for sell→buy only; cash_collector excluded. Cash flow through rotations, not true mark-to-mid P&L.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quote_earned - quote_spent), 0) / 1e7 AS net_cash_m_irt FROM pair_trade.rotation WHERE session_id = $session AND prev_symbol <> 'CASH';

panels.title: Net rotation cash (M IRT)

panels.description: Total fill events this session (rotations + cash-collector), linked via rotation_id when applicable.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS fills FROM pair_trade.fill WHERE session_id = $session;

panels.title: Fills

panels.description: Mark-to-mid P&L over time in million IRT (portfolio_snapshot.pnl / 1e7).

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, pnl / 1e7 AS "P&L M IRT" FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot WHERE session_id = $session AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts;

panels.title: Portfolio P&L vs session start (M IRT)

panels.description: 100 * pnl / session_start_NAV over time. Start NAV = first portfolio_snapshot.portfolio_value for the session.

targets.rawSql: WITH start_nav AS (SELECT portfolio_value AS v FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot WHERE session_id = $session ORDER BY ts ASC LIMIT 1) SELECT p.ts AS time, 100.0 * p.pnl / NULLIF(s.v, 0) AS "P&L %" FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot p CROSS JOIN start_nav s WHERE p.session_id = $session AND $__timeFilter(p.ts) ORDER BY p.ts;

panels.title: Portfolio P&L vs session start (%)

panels.description: Mark-to-mid NAV over time from portfolio_snapshot (IRR / 1e7).

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, portfolio_value / 1e7 AS "Portfolio M IRT" FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot WHERE session_id = $session AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts;

panels.title: Portfolio value (M IRT)

panels.description: Portfolio P&L % (vs session-start NAV) alongside equal-weight mid-price indexes. All = every symbol in the session; Top5 = عیار، طلا، کهربا، گنج، مثقال. Index: 100*(mid_ffill / first_mid - 1); missing mids forward-filled. Portfolio aligned to each signal bin via last portfolio_snapshot.ts ≤ bin_ts.

targets.rawSql:
WITH 
raw AS (
  SELECT bin_ts, symbol, mid_price
  FROM pair_trade.signal_snapshot
  WHERE session_id = $session
),
all_bins AS (SELECT DISTINCT bin_ts FROM raw),
all_syms AS (SELECT DISTINCT symbol FROM raw),
grid AS (
  SELECT b.bin_ts, s.symbol FROM all_bins b CROSS JOIN all_syms s
),
joined AS (
  SELECT g.bin_ts, g.symbol, r.mid_price
  FROM grid g
  LEFT JOIN raw r ON r.bin_ts = g.bin_ts AND r.symbol = g.symbol
),
grp AS (
  SELECT bin_ts, symbol, mid_price,
         COUNT(mid_price) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY bin_ts) AS grp
  FROM joined
),
filled AS (
  SELECT bin_ts, symbol,
         first_value(mid_price) OVER (
           PARTITION BY symbol, grp ORDER BY bin_ts
         ) AS mid_price
  FROM grp
  WHERE grp > 0
),
sym_start AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (symbol) symbol, mid_price AS m0
  FROM filled
  WHERE mid_price IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY symbol, bin_ts
), idx AS (SELECT f.bin_ts AS time, AVG(100.0 * (f.mid_price / NULLIF(ss.m0, 0) - 1)) AS index_pct FROM filled f JOIN sym_start ss ON ss.symbol = f.symbol WHERE f.mid_price IS NOT NULL  AND $__timeFilter(f.bin_ts) GROUP BY f.bin_ts), start_nav AS (SELECT portfolio_value AS v FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot WHERE session_id = $session ORDER BY ts ASC LIMIT 1), port AS (SELECT p.ts, 100.0 * p.pnl / NULLIF(sn.v, 0) AS port_pct FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot p CROSS JOIN start_nav sn WHERE p.session_id = $session) SELECT i.time, lat.port_pct AS "Portfolio %" FROM idx i JOIN LATERAL (SELECT p.port_pct FROM port p WHERE p.ts <= i.time ORDER BY p.ts DESC LIMIT 1) lat ON TRUE ORDER BY i.time;

),

),
sym_start AS (

), idx AS (SELECT f.bin_ts AS time, AVG(100.0 * (f.mid_price / NULLIF(ss.m0, 0) - 1)) AS index_pct FROM filled f JOIN sym_start ss ON ss.symbol = f.symbol WHERE f.mid_price IS NOT NULL  AND $__timeFilter(f.bin_ts) GROUP BY f.bin_ts) SELECT time, index_pct AS "All index %" FROM idx ORDER BY time;

all_bins AS (SELECT DISTINCT bin_ts FROM raw),

),

panels.title: Portfolio return vs benchmark indexes (%)

panels.description: Portfolio P&L % (vs session-start NAV) minus each equal-weight mid index %. Portfolio aligned to each signal bin via last portfolio_snapshot.ts ≤ bin_ts. Positive = outperforming that benchmark since session start. Colors match All/Top5 on the panel to the left.

panels.title: Portfolio excess return vs indexes (%)

panels.description: Share of mark-to-mid NAV per asset over time. IRR = cash; ETF bases valued as units × mid from portfolio_snapshot.marks. Stacked area ≈ 100% composition.

targets.rawSql: SELECT b.ts AS time, 100.0 * CASE WHEN b.asset = 'IRR' THEN b.total ELSE b.total * COALESCE((SELECT kv.value::numeric FROM jsonb_each_text(p.marks) AS kv(key, value) WHERE kv.key LIKE b.asset || '-%' LIMIT 1), 0) END / NULLIF(p.portfolio_value, 0) AS value, b.asset AS metric FROM pair_trade.balance_snapshot b JOIN pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot p ON p.session_id = b.session_id AND p.ts = b.ts WHERE b.session_id = $session AND $__timeFilter(b.ts) ORDER BY b.ts;

panels.title: Portfolio weights by asset (%)

panels.description: Pie of latest asset weights by mark-to-mid value (same valuation as weights chart). Cash = IRR. One slice per asset (time_series + metric); legend shows asset name, value %, and share.

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT MAX(ts) AS ts FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot WHERE session_id = $session), p AS (SELECT ts, portfolio_value, marks FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot WHERE session_id = $session AND ts = (SELECT ts FROM latest)), b AS (SELECT asset, SUM(total) AS total FROM pair_trade.balance_snapshot WHERE session_id = $session AND ts = (SELECT ts FROM latest) GROUP BY asset), valued AS (SELECT p.ts AS time, b.asset AS metric, 100.0 * CASE WHEN b.asset = 'IRR' THEN b.total ELSE b.total * COALESCE((SELECT kv.value::numeric FROM jsonb_each_text(p.marks) AS kv(key, value) WHERE kv.key = b.asset || '-IRR' OR kv.key LIKE b.asset || '-%' LIMIT 1), 0) END / NULLIF(p.portfolio_value, 0) AS value FROM b CROSS JOIN p) SELECT time, value, metric FROM valued WHERE value > 0 ORDER BY value DESC;

panels.title: Latest portfolio composition (%)

panels.description: Free IRR cash from basket_snapshot (M IRT) and open strategy order count.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, quote_balance / 1e7 AS "Cash M IRT" FROM pair_trade.basket_snapshot WHERE session_id = $session AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts;
SELECT ts AS time, pending_order_count AS "Pending orders" FROM pair_trade.basket_snapshot WHERE session_id = $session AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts;

panels.title: Quote balance & pending orders

panels.description: Number of symbols with positive position in basket_snapshot.symbols (jsonb_array_length).

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, jsonb_array_length(symbols) AS "Held ETFs" FROM pair_trade.basket_snapshot WHERE session_id = $session AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts;

panels.title: Held ETF count

panels.description: Cash-collector target: argmin(ret + ba_spread), refreshed on snapshots/ticks.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts, lowest_ret_symbol FROM pair_trade.basket_snapshot WHERE session_id = $session AND lowest_ret_symbol IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 100;

panels.title: Lowest-ret symbol (cash target)

panels.description: Primary signal: EWM log-mid residual (signal_snapshot.ret). Positive = rich vs own EWM; negative = cheap. Rotations sell high ret, buy low ret.

targets.rawSql: SELECT bin_ts AS time, ret AS value, symbol AS metric FROM pair_trade.signal_snapshot WHERE session_id = $session AND $__timeFilter(bin_ts) ORDER BY bin_ts;

panels.title: Return signal by symbol

panels.description: For each bin_ts: ret − mean(ret across symbols). Highlights relative richness/cheapness vs the basket average that tick.

targets.rawSql: SELECT bin_ts AS time, ret - AVG(ret) OVER (PARTITION BY bin_ts) AS value, symbol AS metric FROM pair_trade.signal_snapshot WHERE session_id = $session AND ret IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(bin_ts) ORDER BY bin_ts;

panels.title: Return signal demeaned (cross-section)

panels.description: Relative BA cost: mean((ask−bid)/mid) over the freq bin, displayed as percent (×100).

targets.rawSql: SELECT bin_ts AS time, ba_spread * 100 AS value, symbol AS metric FROM pair_trade.signal_snapshot WHERE session_id = $session AND $__timeFilter(bin_ts) ORDER BY bin_ts;

panels.title: Bid-ask spread % by symbol

panels.description: Latest freq bin. Ordered by ret+ba_spread ASC (cash-collector target at top). Prices in M IRT.

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.symbol, s.ret, s.ba_spread, s.mid_price / 1e7 AS mid_m_irt, s.ret_ask, s.ret_bid, s.ask_price / 1e7 AS ask_m_irt, s.bid_price / 1e7 AS bid_m_irt, (s.ret + s.ba_spread) AS ret_plus_spread, s.bin_ts FROM pair_trade.signal_snapshot s WHERE s.session_id = $session AND s.bin_ts = (SELECT MAX(bin_ts) FROM pair_trade.signal_snapshot WHERE session_id = $session) ORDER BY s.ret + s.ba_spread ASC NULLS LAST;

panels.title: Latest signals (all symbols)

panels.description: Sell→buy only. expected=transition_score; last=ret_bid[prev]−ret_ask[new]; realized=fill VWAPs (pre-fee); realized_net=fee-adjusted VWAPs. Log units ×10000 ≈ bps. Negatives OK.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, transition_score * 10000 AS value, 'expected' AS metric FROM pair_trade.rotation WHERE session_id = $session AND prev_symbol <> 'CASH' AND transition_score IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) UNION ALL SELECT ts, last_edge * 10000, 'last' FROM pair_trade.rotation WHERE session_id = $session AND prev_symbol <> 'CASH' AND last_edge IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) UNION ALL SELECT ts, realized_edge * 10000, 'realized' FROM pair_trade.rotation WHERE session_id = $session AND prev_symbol <> 'CASH' AND realized_edge IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) UNION ALL SELECT ts, realized_edge_net * 10000, 'realized_net' FROM pair_trade.rotation WHERE session_id = $session AND prev_symbol <> 'CASH' AND realized_edge_net IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Rotation edges (bps)

panels.description: Sell→buy only. sell_slippage=log(sell_vwap/intended_sell); buy_slippage=log(buy_vwap/intended_buy). ×10000 ≈ bps. Sell neg=worse; buy pos=worse.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, sell_slippage * 10000 AS value, 'sell_slippage_bps' AS metric FROM pair_trade.rotation WHERE session_id = $session AND prev_symbol <> 'CASH' AND sell_slippage IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) UNION ALL SELECT ts, buy_slippage * 10000, 'buy_slippage_bps' FROM pair_trade.rotation WHERE session_id = $session AND prev_symbol <> 'CASH' AND buy_slippage IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Buy / sell slippage (bps)

panels.description: Seconds from rotation start (sell placed) to buy_complete for sell→buy rotations.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, latency_sec AS "latency_sec", prev_symbol || '→' || new_symbol AS metric FROM pair_trade.rotation WHERE session_id = $session AND prev_symbol <> 'CASH' AND latency_sec IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts;

panels.title: Rotation latency (sec)

panels.description: Running sum of realized_edge (pre-fee) and realized_edge_net (post-fee) for sell→buy (×10000 ≈ bps). Gap between series ≈ cumulative fee drag in edge space.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, SUM(realized_edge) OVER (ORDER BY ts) * 10000 AS "cum realized bps" FROM pair_trade.rotation WHERE session_id = $session AND prev_symbol <> 'CASH' AND realized_edge IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts;

SELECT ts AS time, SUM(realized_edge_net) OVER (ORDER BY ts) * 10000 AS "cum realized_net bps" FROM pair_trade.rotation WHERE session_id = $session AND prev_symbol <> 'CASH' AND realized_edge_net IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts;

panels.title: Cumulative realized edge (bps)

panels.description: Distribution of rotation.status including cash_collector.

targets.rawSql: SELECT NOW() AS time, COUNT(*)::float AS value, status AS metric FROM pair_trade.rotation WHERE session_id = $session GROUP BY status ORDER BY value DESC;

panels.title: Rotation status

panels.description: Sell→buy expected_edge = ret_prev−ret_new−ba_prev−ba_new, shown ×100.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, transition_score * 100 AS "Score %", prev_symbol || '->' || new_symbol AS metric FROM pair_trade.rotation WHERE session_id = $session AND prev_symbol <> 'CASH' AND transition_score IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts;

panels.title: Expected edge (transition_score) ×100

panels.description: Cumulative quote_earned / quote_spent for sell→buy only (cash_collector excluded).

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, SUM(quote_earned) OVER (ORDER BY ts) / 1e7 AS "Earned M IRT" FROM pair_trade.rotation WHERE session_id = $session AND prev_symbol <> 'CASH' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts;
SELECT ts AS time, SUM(quote_spent) OVER (ORDER BY ts) / 1e7 AS "Spent M IRT" FROM pair_trade.rotation WHERE session_id = $session AND prev_symbol <> 'CASH' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts;

panels.title: Cumulative rotation cash (M IRT)

panels.description: Includes cash_collector (prev_symbol=CASH). Edges (incl. realized_edge_net) and fees_m_irt for debugging.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts, CASE WHEN prev_symbol = 'CASH' THEN 'cash_collector' ELSE 'rotation' END AS kind, prev_symbol, new_symbol, status, transition_score, last_edge, realized_edge, realized_edge_net, sell_slippage, buy_slippage, latency_sec, transition_value / 1e7 AS transition_value_m_irt, quote_earned / 1e7 AS earned_m_irt, quote_spent / 1e7 AS spent_m_irt, total_fee_quote / 1e7 AS fees_m_irt, sell_order_id FROM pair_trade.rotation WHERE session_id = $session ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 50;

panels.title: Recent rotations

panels.description: Aggregated fills by side/pair. fee_quote includes percent fees. Notional/fees in M IRT.

targets.rawSql: SELECT side, trading_pair, COUNT(*) AS fills, ROUND(SUM(amount)::numeric, 6) AS base_volume, ROUND((SUM(amount * price) / 1e7)::numeric, 2) AS notional_m_irt, ROUND((SUM(fee_quote) / 1e7)::numeric, 4) AS fees_m_irt, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rotation_id IS NULL) AS unlinked_fills FROM pair_trade.fill WHERE session_id = $session GROUP BY side, trading_pair ORDER BY notional_m_irt DESC;

panels.title: Fill volume by side

panels.description: Running sum of amount×price by side (M IRT).

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, SUM(amount * price) OVER (PARTITION BY side ORDER BY ts) / 1e7 AS value, side || ' M IRT' AS metric FROM pair_trade.fill WHERE session_id = $session AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts;

panels.title: Cumulative fill notional (M IRT)

panels.description: Cumulative quote_spent for cash_collector rotations (prev_symbol=CASH).

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, SUM(quote_spent) OVER (ORDER BY ts) / 1e7 AS "CC spent M IRT" FROM pair_trade.rotation WHERE session_id = $session AND prev_symbol = 'CASH' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts;

panels.title: Cash-collector spend (M IRT)

panels.description: Running sum of fills.fee_quote (percent + flat) in M IRT. Includes rotation fills and cash-collector / unlinked fills — full session fee spend from the exchange.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, SUM(fee_quote) OVER (ORDER BY ts) / 1e7 AS "Fees M IRT" FROM pair_trade.fill WHERE session_id = $session AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts;

panels.title: Cumulative fees (M IRT)

panels.description: Counts of event_log types (timeouts, skips, checkpoints, …).

targets.rawSql: SELECT event_type, COUNT(*) AS value FROM pair_trade.event_log WHERE session_id = $session GROUP BY event_type ORDER BY value DESC;

panels.title: Event types (health)

panels.description: Latest event_log rows for ops debugging.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts, level, event_type, payload FROM pair_trade.event_log WHERE session_id = $session ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 50;

panels.title: Recent events

panels.description: Latest total/available per asset. Prefer weight/composition panels for value view; this keeps raw units.

targets.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (exchange, asset) exchange, asset, CASE WHEN asset = 'IRR' THEN total / 1e7 ELSE total END AS total, CASE WHEN asset = 'IRR' THEN available / 1e7 ELSE available END AS available, CASE WHEN asset = 'IRR' THEN 'M IRT' ELSE 'units' END AS unit, ts FROM pair_trade.balance_snapshot WHERE session_id = $session ORDER BY exchange, asset, ts DESC;

panels.title: Latest balances

list.name: strategy
list.label: Strategy
list.query: SELECT name AS __text, name AS __value FROM pair_trade.strategy ORDER BY name;
list.definition: SELECT name AS __text, name AS __value FROM pair_trade.strategy ORDER BY name;

list.name: session
list.label: Session
list.query: SELECT s.id::text || ' @ ' || to_char(s.started_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS __text, s.id AS __value FROM pair_trade.session s JOIN pair_trade.strategy st ON st.id = s.strategy_id WHERE st.name = '$strategy' ORDER BY s.started_at DESC;
